Held by starter-kit/quality_ratchet.py --precommit, chained into .githooks/pre-commit: a commit that lowers any `min` below, raises any `max`, or removes a gate is refused; tightening and adding pass. Loosening is a plan-mode decision in its own commit with the reason in CHANGELOG.md, committed with --no-verify (SAFEGUARDS.md Blast Radius Limits). Measure with `python3 starter-kit/quality_ratchet.py --run` (about three minutes: it runs bin/tests.sh) and cite the summary line in the close-out receipt (HANDOFFS.md, runtime_smoke); bin/check-handoff lints for it.
_first_tightening_owed: DISCHARGED 2026-09-16 (S23, the first commit after PR #82 merged): `tests-sh-failed` tightened 1 -> 0 and `tests-sh-passed` 138 -> 139 once Test 9 turned green on main. Kept as the record of why the failed-count gate exists: a count gate is blind to health (a failing test still ran), so the FAILED count, held at 0, is what makes the suite's colour a gate. The next tightening is owed whenever a measured value rises: run --run, read the table, raise the floors — never lower them.

A floor taken at the higher state would refuse every close-out.

gates.name: tests-sh-passed

gates.name: tests-sh-failed
gates.why: the suite's colour: a count gate passes over a red test (it still ran); this one does not. 0 since the PR #82 merge (Test 9 was the branch-only failure)

gates.why: test count never drops; green/red is carried by tests-sh-passed

gates.name: commit-msg-selftest

gates.name: pre-commit-selftest
gates.why: exit code: the ledger gate's own checks, on the commit-msg-selftest precedent beside it. Added at S198 with BL-76, where a stale .git/REBASE_HEAD made the hook exit 0 before BOTH gates it chains -- the FM #27 ledger gate and quality_ratchet.py --precommit -- for five weeks and 69 commits, and nothing looked. A hook is the one gate no other gate watches: it fails OPEN, so its failure mode is silence. Ten checks, RED-first against the shipped hook (1 red before, 0 after) and mutation-tested (9 mutants, 9 killed). It asserts BOTH halves, because the cheap fix over-corrects: a leaked REBASE_HEAD must still be refused, AND every genuinely in-progress state -- rebase-merge, rebase-apply, MERGE_HEAD, CHERRY_PICK_HEAD -- must still be skipped.
